inputs.text: That protest at Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday was a warning they’d rather dismiss as unrest. The National Assembly’s “reform” bills look less like routine change than a coordinated grab for control, dressed up in respectable language. When both the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations are sounding the alarm, it’s hard to believe the people pushing this agenda don’t know who will pay the price. The real question is who stands to gain from calling it reform.
